body.prompt: The same woman moves slowly from one yoga position into the next in one continuous movement. Fixed camera, eye level, full body always inside the frame, plain warm cream paper background, soft daylight, photoreal, her face unchanged, one single tied ponytail the whole time, same clothes. Calm pacing.
